anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Reboiler heater T701 jumps from ~348 °C to 360.8 then 381.4 °C in two minutes after a slow ~0.1 °C/min ramp
Second reboiler heater cools slightly (53.4→52.9 °C) while T701 spikes
Reboiler vessel only at ~44 °C despite T701 >380 °C, indicating poor heat transfer / possible dry or low liquid contact
Buffer-vessel dP steps from ~2 to 5.7/5.0 mbar coincident with the heater excursion
System pressure dips to 293.9 mbar at same time
Reflux flow essentially zero throughout; no boil-up established

args.missing_evidence: Reboiler liquid level/LS701 trend and heater duty setpoint history to distinguish a runaway heater controller from loss of liquid contact (dry heater); also a distillate composition sample once product flow starts
